verdict.rationale: Outbound webhooks are a fair axis for an observability SaaS like Datadog, but nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Monitors, Incident Management and API Reference items are titles only, and the integrations listings name tools without describing webhook subscriptions. Absent evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
